description: Squeezes the spectrum in frequency around a specified centre: all spectral data is compressed toward centrefrq by the squeeze factor (< 1), narrowing the sound's frequency footprint. Both parameters are time-variable (banner: 'All parameters may vray over time' - CDP's own typo) and both verified breakpoint-capable (centrefrq 200-to-3000 and squeeze 0.1-to-0.9 ramps each differ from both scalar-endpoint renders). squeeze's enforced floor is analysis-dependent ('1.5' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[2] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.001949 to 1.000000)'); centrefrq runs 0 to nyquist. Static duration (2.0230 / 1.5209); deterministic. DIVERGENCE vs afta8, which marks it '[Doesn't work?]': runs cleanly here. Operates on PVOC analysis files (.ana).
musical_use: Frequency-domain imploder: unlike a transpose (which shifts everything by a ratio), squeeze CONTRACTS the spectrum toward a focal point - partial spacing shrinks, harmonicity collapses, and pitched material congeals toward a resonant knot at centrefrq. Mild squeeze (0.7-0.9) reads as darkening/detuning; heavy (0.05-0.3) turns anything into a narrow tuned band with inharmonic clustering, halfway to ring modulation in colour. The breakpoint pair is the show: sweep centrefrq while squeezing and the whole sound funnels chasing the moving centre; ramp squeeze from 1.0 downward for a progressive spectral collapse (1.0 = essentially intact). Kin to specfnu's squeeze mode but standalone, with a freely placeable (and movable) centre.

centrefrq.description: Frequency around which spectral data is squeezed. CDP-enforced 0 to nyquist ('30000' refused verbatim: 'Parameter[1] Value (30000.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 22050.000000)'). Breakpoint verified.

squeeze.description: Amount of spectral compression toward the centre (< 1; smaller = tighter). CDP-enforced with an analysis-dependent floor: '1.5' refused verbatim quoting '(0.001949 to 1.000000)'. Breakpoint verified.

examples.description: Congeal a source toward a 500 Hz knot.
examples.expected_use: Partial spacing collapses to 30%; strong inharmonic clustering around 500 Hz.

examples.description: Progressive collapse chasing a rising centre.
examples.expected_use: The spectrum funnels tighter and tighter while its focal point sweeps upward.

known_issues: The banner's time-variability line carries CDP's own typo ('may vray over time') - both parameters ARE breakpoint-capable (verified).
squeeze's floor is analysis-dependent (0.001949 quoted on the probe analysis); values must be < 1 - there is no spectral EXPAND here (see stretch spectrum for that direction).
